recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the CDS/CQI work group wants a broader editorial rewrite of the evaluation-context section outside the scope of FHIR-16711.
issue_request: FHIR-16711 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification STU3 CDS issue asking that the Clinical Reasoning text be updated because a Patient-based FHIRPath example seemed inappropriate when Patient does not itself support expression elements; the resolution was to reflect the new Expression data type.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-16711 was found. The Patient `%context.name.given` example originated in the GF#14890 Clinical Reasoning content import, while related 2018 changes updated dynamicValue examples to the Expression structure and revised the page to state that Clinical Reasoning resources use the Expression datatype, matching the Jira comment that the issue had already been effectively applied.
additional_context: The Jira comments clarify that the Patient example is a FHIRPath expression evaluation-context example, not an example of a Patient containing a FHIR Expression element. The current Using Expressions page separately documents Expression datatype use and ActivityDefinition/PlanDefinition dynamicValue examples, then uses Patient only as the evaluated context. Zulip only contained the tracker bot post and Confluence had no FHIR-16711 references or relevant hits. FHIR-16783 is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-16705 and FHIR-16702 were encountered as same-family context but not separately decided.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk is needed because replacing Patient with PlanDefinition or ActivityDefinition would make the evaluation-context example less precise, while the Expression datatype update requested by the final resolution is already present in current source.
